base.description: CRS328-24P-4S+RM - 24 10/100/1000 PoE-out ports, four SFP+ cages and the RJ45 console, with a built-in 500 W AC supply and two fans. The box holds rack ears, a K-54 kit and an IEC cord.

description: MikroTik CRS328-24P-4S+RM is a fixed 1U Cloud Router Switch with PoE out. It has 24 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports that supply PoE (802.3af/at, or 26 V or 53 V passive, chosen per port). It also has four SFP+ cages and an RJ45 serial console, and runs SwOS or RouterOS (dual boot). The front carries the 24 jacks in three blocks of four columns by two rows under an orange PoE-out band. A pair of lamps sits above each column and another pair below it, each lamp numbered. The four SFP+ cages are a block of two by two with a numbered lamp under each. The front also has the CONSOLE jack, the RESET and MODE buttons and the PWR, USR, FAN and PoE lamps. The 500 W AC supply and the two fans are built into the chassis, so there are no bays. The fans draw through grilles in the right wall. No document held shows the rear, so the rear is not drawn and the AC inlet is not placed.

name: crs328-24p-4s-plus-rm

built-in-power-and-fans.note: The brochure says the 1U case has a 100 - 240 V AC 500 W power supply built in; the product page lists one AC input, one PSU slot and two fans. No document held shows a removable supply module or gives a supply part number, so the supply is part of the chassis and there are no bays, as on juniper/ex2300-24t. The two fans are the two hexagonal grilles the drawing's right side view and photograph 1494 show.

buttons.note: Two round buttons printed RESET and MODE on the metal (the product page lists "Mode button: Yes"). Both are drawn with the library's recessed reset-button part; the MODE one carries function mode. The drawing gives their centres.

chassis.note: 443 wide, 44.3 high, 298 deep. The brochure and the product page print 443 x 300 x 44 mm; the drawing's 298 is carried and the 300 is declared a conflict, the 2 mm being the cable-management loop and the front lip. The 7 mm the drawing dimensions is a loop standing off the front, an accessory and not part of the depth. 443 is the body between the ear folds (the top plan shows no ears).

colour.note: medians of photograph 1493: face #e9e9e9, lid #e1e1e1. The chassis colour is the face's.

console.note: The RJ45 serial port (brochure: Serial port RJ45) is the shielded jack under the printed CONSOLE. The brochure and the product page list no separate 10/100 management port for this model, and the front has none.

datasheet.note: The brochure is MikroTik's datasheet for the model: product code CRS328-24P-4S+RM, CPU 98DX3236 800 MHz, 512 MB RAM, 16 MB flash, 24 10/100/1000 ports, four SFP+ cages, SwOS / RouterOS (dual boot), 100 - 240 V input, two fans, 443 x 300 x 44 mm, -20 to +60 C tested, 44 W, serial RJ45; a 100 - 240 V AC 500 W built-in supply, 450 W guaranteed for PoE (3 x 150 W per eight ports), up to 30 W per port at high voltage and 26 W at low voltage. The brochure's 44 W is printed "without PoE devices connected"; the product page gives 44 W as "without attachments" and 494 W as the maximum, which is that 44 W plus the 450 W PoE budget. Each figure is filed as the document words it.

ears.note: Rack ears are in the box (product page, Included parts: Rackmount ears; the product page also lists a K-54 kit and an IEC cord, and no held document says what the K-54 kit is, so no kit is placed). The drawing's front view and top plan show the body and the 7 mm cable loop, with no ear plate, so the ears are shipped flush with the face and drawn at the face plane; the ears and the loop are not drawn.

front-layout.note: From the drawing's front view. Three jack plates, each 59.9 x 26.1 at 63.0, 133.3 and 203.7 mm (70.3 mm step), top at 11.6 mm, four columns of two jacks on the 13.97 mm registry pitch (55.9 mm for four, so the plate's 59.9 holds them with 2.0 mm each side), first jack at 66.05 mm; the lower row's jack centre line is 14.1 mm below the plate top and the upper row 13.4 mm above it; the upper jacks' latch notch is up, the lower's down. The SFP+ block is 30.2 x 26.4 at 274.7 mm, top 11.2 mm, two cages by two, each cage opening 14.5 x 10.0 (registry) on a 15.1 mm column pitch and 14.0 mm row pitch. The CONSOLE jack is the drawn 15.9 x 12.6 square at 311.8 mm, 25.2 mm, and the registry jack is centred in it. The two round buttons are drawn 4.3 mm across at centres 332.7 and 342.7 mm, 33.3 mm. The orange PoE-out band and the plate colours are the photograph's medians (band #e9b159, plate #bcbdbd, face #e9e9e9).

gate-1.note: The drawing prints no height. The front view's body is 1864 px wide in a 1.6 times enlargement of the 200 dpi render for the printed 443 (4.208 px per mm) and 190 px tall, which reads 45.2 mm over the lip lines; the side view is 1709 px for the printed 298 (5.735 px per mm) and 254 px tall, 44.3 mm, the figure the sister drawings of the CRS354 print. The side view's 44.3 is carried and the brochure's 44 is its rounding. Every x and y below is taken at 4.208 px per mm from the body's top-left corner of the front view.

lamps.note: estimated - the drawing shows no lamp. They are read off photograph 1493, which looks down on the face (its face is 0.82 of the true height), so x is taken across the face at 4.145 px per mm and y is estimated. Above each column of two jacks sit two lamps, and below it two more, each printed with a number: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 above and the same below for the first eight ports, then 9 to 16 and 17 to 24. So every port has a lamp above and a lamp below, both numbered with the port. The lamp pair is 5.8 mm apart, centred 0.5 mm left of the column, the upper lamp centre at 7.0 mm and the lower at 41.0 mm. The numbers are printed inside the lamp boxes; silkscreen is painted under a placed lamp, so they are drawn just above the upper lamp (4.6 mm) and just above the lower one (39.0 mm). On the band's left wing are three round lamps (2.0 mm, the library's led-dot) at centres 55.9, 58.8 and 61.6 mm, 10.4 mm down, read off photograph 1493 at 4.5 px per mm across the face: the first is green, the second red and the third black, under the legends 26 V, 53 V and PoE out. The green and red are given as the lamp's lit colour (#22c55e, #ef4444); the black one is unlit. The legends are 1.8 mm, turned to read upward as printed, the largest the 2.9 mm lamp pitch allows. The quick guide G1-b holds no LED table and the brochure none, so what the three lamps show is a gap. Under the console are four lamps PWR, USR, FAN and PoE at 309.9, 317.0, 323.9 and 330.9 mm, the FAN and PoE pair on an orange strip headed FAULT. No document held says what a lamp shows.

poe-band.note: estimated - the drawing shows no band. Measured on photograph 1493 against the front plate edges, which the drawing fixes, at the render's 4.5 px per mm across the face; the photo looks down, so y is taken at the face's 0.82 compression. The band is a frame on the tops of the three plates and down the left of the first. Its top bar is 4.0 mm deep, from 7.6 mm to the plate tops at 11.6 mm, and runs from the first plate's left edge (63.0 mm) to the third plate's right edge (264.0 mm), across the two gaps, and the numbered upper lamps sit on its top edge. At the left it widens into a wing 8.9 mm wide at the top (54.1 to 63.0 mm) whose outer edge slants inward to 61.5 mm at the plates' foot, 37.7 mm. The wing carries the 26 V, 53 V and PoE out lamps and legends; it is drawn in three pieces (above the lamps, a strip behind them, below them) so no printed piece lies under a lamp. The edge positions are read to about 1 mm.

port-numbering.note: estimated - the metal prints a number only on the lamps. Which jack of a column takes which number is not printed, and no held document says (the block diagram gives only Ether 1-8, 9-16 and 17-24 as the three blocks). The pilot's convention is followed: the lower jack of a column takes the odd number, the upper the even, and the left lamp of a pair is the odd port's. The four SFP+ cages are printed 1 and 2 under the left column and 3 and 4 under the right; which cage of a column takes which number is not printed either, and the upper cage is taken as the lower number.

rear-layout.note: No held document shows the rear: the drawing has front, side, top and isometric views, the isometric hides the rear, and neither studio photograph looks at it. The rear is left empty and the AC inlet is not placed; no other model's rear is used. The export therefore carries no power port.

sfp-plus.note: Four SFP+ cages (brochure: SFP+ cages 4; block diagram SFP+ 1 to 4) in a block of two by two. The rotated legend SFP+ is on the right of the block. The cage is the registry's std/sfp, which also takes 1.25 Gb SFP.

side-layout.note: The drawing's side view is the right wall, front at the left (the three-quarter photograph 1494 shows the right wall with a grille). Two round hex-pattern fan grilles, each 37.5 mm across, centres 67.3 mm and 202.8 mm from the front and 22.5 mm down. The side view is 5.735 px per mm. The screws and the rear plate line are not drawn.
